newsitem.title: JAPAN: YAMAICHI SEC SAYS TOP OFFICIALS LIKELY TO RESIGN.
newsitem.headline: YAMAICHI SEC SAYS TOP OFFICIALS LIKELY TO RESIGN.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd said on Monday that its chairman, president and five vice presidents were likely to resign over a high-profile racketeer payoff scandal.
The brokerage will hold a board meeting at 9 a.m. (0000 GMT) on Monday to discuss and decide on the top management, a Yamaichi spokesman said.
The spokesman said senior managing director Shoji Saotome was likely to replace chairman Tsugio Yukihira and senior managing director Shohei Nozawa was likely to succeed president Atsuo Miki.
Yamaichi plans to hold a news conference after the board meeting is over, but the time has not yet been set, the spokesman said.
